verdict.rationale: Luma's own API exposes much of the core creative surface: text-, image- and video-to-video, character reference, keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR/EXR export, and Multi-Keyframe described as "exposed at the API." Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and several UI features have no documented API counterpart. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of Modify Video V2, Reframe, motion/camera transfer, Luma Skills and the browser workspace's agent workflows, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
